name: Nakhonsawan 21 2026
short_description: Nakhonsawan 21 2026 is on Sunday 4 October 2026 at Sawan Park in Nakhon Sawan, over 3.3 km, 10 km and 21.1 km.
ai_summary: Nakhonsawan 21 2026 is organised by the Khon Mueang Prabang Running Club at Sawan Park, Nakhon Sawan, with entries taken on RUNLAH. The half marathon (21.1 km) starts at 05:00, the 10 km at 05:30 and the 3.3 km fun run at 06:00. Every 21 km finisher receives a finisher shirt, and trophies are awarded by age group for men and women.

faqs.question: What time does the Nakhonsawan 21 half marathon start?
faqs.answer: Check-in opens at 04:00 on Sunday 4 October 2026 at Sawan Park. The 21.1 km starts at 05:00, the 10 km at 05:30 and the 3.3 km fun run at 06:00.

faqs.question: Where do I collect my Nakhonsawan 21 race pack?
faqs.answer: Race packs are collected at Sawan Park on Saturday 3 October 2026 from 11:00 to 19:00. Bring your registration number or barcode and an ID card or passport; a representative can collect with a copy of your ID.
